body:
Evidence-first review of PR #1 (riatzukiza/eros-eris-field, base 3af779f3 → head ac2dfb79): a planning PR carrying the physical-kernel owning plan (393 lines) + proposed ABI EDN (115 lines, :unimplemented), a new pinned eta-mu evidence-review workflow, the byte-identical auto-merge → .disabled rename, two bounded .gitignore entries, new AGENTS.md, a rewritten agent-workflows.md, 9 evidence JSONs, and append-only receipts (18 rows) / ledger (15 entries). All 20 full-diff pages (18 changed paths, 1430+/101-) were read and assessed; the 300KB preview was not used as review input.

Deterministic evidence: exact-head clean checkout; diff_stat, diff_hygiene and the nbb ABI-EDN parse all exited 0 with no errors. Independently verified against the tree: plan↔ABI agreement across all nine declared operations (restore's ten validations, confirm-feedback's seven ack fields/six matches, quantum 10000µs/100 substeps, xorshift32 [13,17,5], safe-integer range, replay tolerances, layer keys, exchange min() formula, and the deflection convention including its worked-example arithmetic), the two historical P1 findings settled by :restore and :confirm-feedback, muse/agents pins byte-identical to this run's .review-context metadata, .gitignore base prefix preserved with only two rooted generated dirs, every local file referenced by the docs present on disk, graph-ant Math.random / absent license / external tsconfig claims all true, no credential material anywhere in the diff, and all 20 pages consistent.

Candidates (2) — classified before the adversarial note, none confirmed:
- Needs-human, non-blocking (medium): the caller forwards ETA_MU_APP_ID/ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY to the external reusable workflow pinned at b03cb584 while also injecting an evidence-gate script that runs `npx --yes nbb@1.4.207`; whether the App key reaches that step's env depends on the pinned external blob. Caller-side facts argue against automatic exposure (step-level secret semantics, script references no secrets, fork PRs get no secrets, App-key publication proven under read-only permissions), but the PR's only hash-bound env inspection covers the prior 45ec644c pin — an owning human should audit b03cb584's gate-step env or re-run the 45ec-style inspection.
- Rejected: alleged missing-:repo contract violation in .ημ/receipts.edn rows 1–13 — the canonical promethean.receipts/v2 contract requires no :repo key; rows verified conformant, and the stricter native reader's requirement, its quoted failures, and the human-directed append-only remediation are all documented inside this PR with every post-discovery row carrying :repo.

Non-blocking notes: the PR body's changed-input enumeration and head metadata are stale relative to the actual head (claims 16 inputs/1215 insertions/head b9684c4; the diff has 18 paths/1430 insertions at ac2dfb7, including two evidence JSONs the body omits) — untrusted metadata, the full diff was reviewed completely; no gate parses receipts.edn or the evidence JSONs (only the ABI EDN is parsed, as the docs accurately state); :repo values differ across receipt rows 14–18 (three different repository names) with the reader's semantics indeterminable in-repo; Foresight PR22/26 links were unreachable from this environment and treated as cited observations only; no tests are claimed or expected for this planning PR — implementation RED/GREEN, licensing adoption, calibration/load proof, native Rheos readiness and deployment remain explicitly open gates by design.

No confirmed findings; deterministic gates passed but approval rests on the complete assessment, not gate status. Verdict: APPROVE.
